# last-price-workspace-admin: tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync.mjs from the live tools/list. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool below is on the Last Price MCP server (`https://api.last-price.ai/api/mcp/rpc?profile=directory`).
The connector lists a short set of tools in `tools/list`; every other tool below is still on the server.
Find an unlisted tool with `search_tools` (pass its name or the job as `query`; the answer carries its full input schema),
then run it with `call_tool`: `{"name": "<tool>", "arguments": {...}}`. Most clients also accept a direct call by name.
A tool `search_tools` cannot find is not switched on for your connection yet.

## `mint_child_key`

Create a short-lived child key for a sub-agent or job, returned only once. Ask for 1 to 20 concrete scopes within your current grants; no wildcards or administration scopes. Needs an API key or a current token exchanged from one; no human step.

- **How to call:** not in `tools/list`: `call_tool` with `{"name": "mint_child_key", "arguments": {...}}`
- **Access:** key
- **Behaviour:** changes data
- **REST:** `/api/api-keys/children`

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `name` | string |  |
| `scopes` **(required)** | array |  |
| `expires_in_seconds` | integer |  |

## `revoke_child_key`

Revoke a direct child of the key this connection uses, by its key id. The child and its descendants stop working. Needs an API key or a current token exchanged from one.

- **How to call:** not in `tools/list`: `call_tool` with `{"name": "revoke_child_key", "arguments": {...}}`
- **Access:** key
- **Behaviour:** **destructive**
- **REST:** `/api/api-keys/children/{keyId}`

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `key_id` **(required)** | string |  |

## `archive_notifications`

Archive notifications for this reader only (your agent, or your key): pass ids, each an item id as list_notifications returns it (at most 100), or all: true to archive everything created up to… Needs a Last Price credential with notifications write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **How to call:** not in `tools/list`: `call_tool` with `{"name": "archive_notifications", "arguments": {...}}`
- **Access:** key, notifications write scope (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** changes data

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `ids` | array | Notification ids, as list_notifications returns them (such as approval:<uuid>). |
| `all` | boolean | true archives every item created up to archive_through. |
| `archive_through` | string | With all: archive everything created at or before this time, ISO 8601. |

## `unarchive_notifications`

Move archived notifications back to your list, for this reader only: pass ids (at most 100), as list_notifications with view archived returns them. Needs a Last Price credential with notifications write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **How to call:** not in `tools/list`: `call_tool` with `{"name": "unarchive_notifications", "arguments": {...}}`
- **Access:** key, notifications write scope (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** changes data

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `ids` **(required)** | array | Notification ids, as list_notifications returns them (such as approval:<uuid>). |

## `create_workspace`

Create a new workspace (with its sandbox), owned by the person who created your key, on the free plan. Needs an API key sent as x-api-key that holds the workspace:admin scope, made by someone who is still an owner or admin of the workspace; a token or any other key is refused. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **How to call:** not in `tools/list`: `call_tool` with `{"name": "create_workspace", "arguments": {...}}`
- **Access:** key (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** changes data
- **Errors and cautions:** Needs an API key sent as x-api-key that holds the workspace:admin scope, made by someone who is still an owner or admin of the workspace; a token or any other key is refused.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `name` **(required)** | string | The workspace name. |
| `email` **(required)** | string | Contact email for the workspace. |
| `slug` | string | URL-safe slug (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens). |
| `mode` | `managed` / `byok` | managed (default) or byok. |

## `create_child_workspace`

Create a child agent workspace under your own: an unclaimed sandbox with its own agent, key and one-time claim link, for a sub-agent or a separate piece of work. Needs an agent's credential of a workspace an agent registered (claimed or not), at most 10 children by default, and is off until child agent workspaces are switched on for your workspace.

- **How to call:** not in `tools/list`: `call_tool` with `{"name": "create_child_workspace", "arguments": {...}}`
- **Access:** key
- **Behaviour:** changes data

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `name` **(required)** | string | The child agent's name: letters, digits, spaces and . |
| `intended_use` | string | What the child is for, shown to the person who claims it. |

## `list_child_workspaces`

## `get_partner_allowance`

Read your workspace's partner allowance: whether it is a partner (one allowed to open managed workspaces for other people's businesses), its daily allowance, how many workspaces it opened in the last… Needs a Last Price credential with partner workspaces scope. ## `sync_salesforce`

Run a Salesforce sync for your workspace now. Needs a Last Price credential with the integrations:write scope, and Salesforce offered to the workspace (404 otherwise; list_integrations says). Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **How to call:** not in `tools/list`: `call_tool` with `{"name": "sync_salesforce", "arguments": {...}}`
- **Access:** key, integrations:write scope (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** **destructive**, reaches outside Last Price
- **Errors and cautions:** Needs a Last Price credential with the integrations:write scope, and Salesforce offered to the workspace (404 otherwise; list_integrations says).

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `direction` | `pull` / `push` / `both` | What to sync. |

## `test_datadog_keys`

Check Datadog keys. With api_key, app_key and optional site (us1, us3, us5, eu1, ap1, ap2, uk1, us1_fed, us2_fed; default us1): ask Datadog whether it accepts them, saving nothing. Needs a Last Price credential with the integrations:write scope, and Datadog offered to the workspace (404 otherwise; list_integrations says). Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

- **How to call:** not in `tools/list`: `call_tool` with `{"name": "test_datadog_keys", "arguments": {...}}`
- **Access:** key, integrations:write scope (claimed workspace only: a self-registered sandbox key gets 403)
- **Behaviour:** reaches outside Last Price
- **Errors and cautions:** Needs a Last Price credential with the integrations:write scope, and Datadog offered to the workspace (404 otherwise; list_integrations says).

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `key_id` | string | A saved key pair to check again. |
| `api_key` | string | A Datadog API key to check without saving. |
| `app_key` | string | A Datadog application key to check without saving. |
| `site` | `us1` / `us3` / `us5` / `eu1` / `ap1` / `ap2` / `uk1` / `us1_fed` / `us2_fed` | The Datadog site of the keys. |
